title: Pesalo 2027: fix the leaking bucket, then grow
decision_requested: Approve reliability and onboarding work plus a three-week cohort analysis now; hold the TZS 2.5 billion acquisition and Gold spend until retention evidence meets an agreed threshold
governing_thought: Pesalo loses most new users within a month and one in six cash-outs fails; fix reliability and prove the churn link before paying to acquire more users

sections.assertion: Most new Pesalo users stop transacting within a month
sections.exhibit: Registered vs 30-day active vs 30-day retained, Q2 2026
sections.uncertainty: Retention definition not documented; only 30-day data available

sections.assertion: Nearly one in five cash-out attempts failed in Q2, and failed withdrawals are the top complaint in one-star reviews
sections.audience_decision: Accept reliability as a leading suspect
sections.notes: Reviews are a biased sample of unhappy users
sections.uncertainty: Review sample is self-selected; failure causes beyond float not broken out

sections.assertion: The growth problem looks like a leaking bucket, not a shortage of sign-ups; we will confirm the churn link within three weeks
sections.audience_decision: Accept the working diagnosis and the test
sections.exhibit: Leaking bucket diagram with the cohort test
sections.uncertainty: The link between failed cash-outs and churn is a hypothesis until the cohort analysis is done

sections.assertion: The market is not 117 million customers: subscriptions exceed the population, so they are not people
sections.notes: Replace with survey-based adults with mobile money access in target areas
sections.uncertainty: People-based market size not yet built
source_locators: TCRA quarter ending June 2026, p.13 Table 1.1.1 and glossary

sections.assertion: The radio test does not prove ROI: most radio weeks were salary weeks
sections.uncertainty: Stratified differences rest on very few weeks; a holdout test is needed

sections.assertion: Fund reliability and onboarding now; release acquisition spend only when retention clears an agreed threshold
sections.exhibit: Choice on a page with non-choices and gates
sections.uncertainty: Conditional on the cohort analysis confirming that failed cash-outs drive churn

sections.assertion: The viral campaign and Pesalo Gold are held, not killed: each needs evidence first
sections.uncertainty: Willingness to pay for Gold is untested rather than disproven

sections.assertion: Four actions: float partner, cohort analysis, onboarding redesign, radio holdout test
sections.uncertainty: Float partner fee not yet quoted

sections.assertion: Success means reliable cash-outs, retained savers and active savers, not followers or downloads
Approve the reliability plan today; return in six weeks with cohort results and an acquisition gate
